objectives_and_approach.summary: Students investigate the business life cycle from seed to post-maturity; examine business data and information; and apply concepts, theories and strategies for leadership, management and entrepreneurship across finance, human resources, marketing and operations.
objectives_and_approach.inquiry_and_evaluation: Learning integrates inquiry with authentic case studies. Students analyse and interpret business data and information and evaluate strategies using competitiveness, effectiveness, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

units.title: Business creation
units.subject_matter: Seed-stage business ideas, strategic planning, business environments, leadership, management, entrepreneurship, finance, human resources, marketing, operations and technology; SWOT and PEST analysis.

units.title: Business growth
units.subject_matter: Start-up and growth stages, financial and human-resource strategies, market entry and authentic franchise or market-entry case studies; STEEPLE, break-even, SWOT and USP analysis.

units.title: Business diversification
units.subject_matter: Maturity-stage diversification, global-market expansion and competitive advantage; SWOT, STEEPLE, USP and power-interest-grid analysis; an Australian business expanding into an Asian market.

units.title: Business evolution
units.subject_matter: Post-maturity repositioning and transformation; change management and leadership across finance, human resources, marketing and operations; SWOT, STEEPLE, force-field and Porter's five-forces analysis.

assessment_model.marking_and_confirmation: Schools mark the internal assessment instruments using ISMGs and report provisional criterion marks to QCAA. Confirmed internal results are combined with the QCAA-developed and marked external assessment result.
